Fierce Soldier sprites
======================

Author: Vircon32 (Carra)
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/fierce-soldier-sprites
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY 4.0)
License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The soldier, enemy and scenery sprites used in this project come from the
"Fierce Soldier sprites" pack. Frames were cropped, scaled to the game's
internal resolution and rearranged into sprite sheets. No other changes were
made to the original artwork.

Attribution is required by the license. See the project README for the
attribution notice.
